methodology.admission: previous eligible metadata must match at least75%bytes at fixed chunk boundaries; previous whole-frame ratio must be in[1/8,7/8]; outside-ratio framed results fall back to whole encoding
methodology.chunk_key: one-shot blake3::hash; exact full-byte equality required on hits
methodology.cold_definition: empty frame cache and previous candidate; equally primed reusable codec contexts; clearing outside timed region
methodology.retention_accounting: actual raw and encoded Vec capacities plus512bytes per frame,4096byte index reserve, previous raw capacity+128bytes; shared1MiB budget
methodology.timing: codec only; full checks outside encode timings; full decode timing includes length and content hash
